dataset: Toybox (Wang et al. 2018), https://aivaslab.github.io/toybox/ ; videos from the Zenodo archives (vehicles: record 1290757, animals: record 1289936), streamed and only the needed files kept
intended_transformation: approximately 90 degrees counter-clockwise in-plane rotation (as seen in the image)
labeling: approximate, visually checked pilot question; NOT calibrated geometric ground truth. Frames chosen by visual inspection of timestamped contact sheets; the SIFT angle estimate (angle.py) was used as a check where it was reliable. Orientations are approximate (manual rotation by a person, head-mounted camera).

demos.check: visual: upright -> roof pointing left, wheels right; SIFT unreliable (<=5 inliers)
visual: vertical with wheels right and tow hook up -> upside down; before frame is tilted by roughly 10-15 degrees; SIFT unreliable
visual: upside down with head right -> vertical with head up; not SIFT-checked

uncertainty: Rotations are performed by hand; angles are approximate (roughly +-15 degrees).
Toybox uses a head-mounted camera; the camera may move slightly between frames.
The truck_28 'before' frame is tilted by roughly 10-15 degrees from vertical.
Hands partly occlude the objects; hand positions differ between frames.
Some rotation may be slightly out of plane.
